context: A boss debriefs after a CSR meeting
purpose: Teach: 分布/良心/防御/加害/捜索/河川/大震災/楽観

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: CSR会議、被災地支援の分布、整理できたな。
lines.en: CSR meeting — disaster-aid distribution is mapped out clearly.
lines.style: Crisp, approving. Measured pace. Brief weight on the acknowledgment, eyes steady. The tone of someone reviewing completed work with satisfaction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。河川沿いの工場、防御整備の見直し、急務です。
lines.en: Yes. Riverside plants — defense reviews need to happen right away.
lines.style: Measured, professional clarity. Direct eye contact. Slightly lean forward on the urgency. No hesitation; this is fact-based urgency, not alarm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 良心的なサプライヤーと、組んで進めよう。
lines.en: Let's move forward partnering with suppliers who actually care about this.
lines.style: Decided and warm. Solid conviction on the direction. Not lecturing — inviting collaboration. Lean back slightly; this is a course set.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 過去の加害事例、捜索段階で対処済みです。
lines.en: Past cases of harm — we've already dealt with them in the vetting phase.
lines.style: Steady, competent briefing. Factual, without defensiveness. Light emphasis on the completion. Professional reassurance that the groundwork is done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 大震災の教訓を忘れず、楽観しない経営を。
lines.en: Don't forget what the great earthquake taught us. Manage without false optimism.
lines.style: Serious, weathered. Slower pace. Weight of experience in the opening. Slight pause before the final phrase — gravity, not harshness. The tone of someone who remembers.
